target: superpopulation NIE at treatment level 1 versus 0
split_policy: Fresh mechanism parameters and observation rows in each partition. Source OOD and composition OOD are never used for training, DEV selection or calibration. Jones presets are one provenance group; Shan observation-mechanism duplicates are one complete-data preset.
adaptations: Remove induced-confounder paths in the structural equations; export complete-data variables before missingness; recompute NIE truth, never reuse another estimand's truth.

model.backbone: custom MediPFN v2, initialized from new weights

selection: Fixed family-balanced independent same-source DEV factual loss only; retain best and last checkpoints. No OOD or calibration labels for selection.
acceleration: GPU mixed precision, TF32, shared inducing-token context, asynchronous next-batch preparation and parallel vectorized generators. Benchmark before changing effective batch size or requesting multiple GPUs.
stages: nested eta regression with frozen factual teacher
evaluation: Coverage, interval length, interval score, point error, failure rates, wall time; mechanism-cluster paired uncertainty. Keep all prespecified results and adverse findings.
optional_backbone_queue: TabCon-backbone-style frozen TabPFN-v3 with mediation-specific uncertainty adaptation, subject to actual weight/API validation
TabPFN mediation adapter or cross-task fine-tuning, using separated table contexts and DEV-only selection
prior_assets: Current v1 manuscript, datasets, checkpoints, logs and paused jobs are preserved. No v1 paper claims or results change during v2 development.
